own:
Unless we want to become the supreme knowledge leaders of every single possible payment method that matches every single possible currency, we should probably just leave it so they can choose which currencies they work with and which payment methods they offer, and just hope that they match, unless we have some way of verifying this.

If we can verify and know 100% which every single payment method matches with every single currency and we are invaluable in this, then I'm okay with having it so they match up correctly. But maybe we should just let them pick the currencies they deal with and the payment methods that they deal with, and then the person who is selling or buying, who's going to click on the ad, they're going to know which one makes sense. So they're going to click on the one, they're going to click on the drop downs on the ad where they drop down and select the currency, then they drop down and they select the payment method. They will know which ones make sense.
question: When a vendor posts an offer, do they pick payment methods first, or currencies first?
